name: TalkSport (DAB+ Malta)
description: TalkSport is broadcast in Malta on DAB+ (Labelled as 'Sports Channel' or 'Talk Sport'). It provides live English Premier League (EPL) commentary, which is highly relevant for Kalshi market bettors.
notes: Matches typically run on Saturday (Oct 17) and Sunday (Oct 18). You need a DAB+ receiver (not standard FM/AM) to pick this up locally over the air.

name: Vibe FM
description: Official Radio Partner for the Malta Premier League. They broadcast updates and local matches.
notes: Good for local football, though less likely to be on US prediction markets like Kalshi.

name: Radio Sportiva
description: Italian sports radio station covering Serie A and global sports.
notes: Broadcast is in Italian. Available via DAB+.

name: BBC World Service via Campus FM
description: Campus FM simulcasts BBC World Service, which often carries BBC Sport (Sportsworld) on weekends for live EPL updates.
notes: Live match commentary availability depends on the exact BBC World Service schedule for the weekend of Oct 17-18, 2026.
